subject: Pilot credits & pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits & pricing follow-up

Hi John —

Great to meet today — thanks for walking through Acme's ingestion and the demo. Quick recap and next steps from my side: 

- Redwood pilot: 30-day evaluation with shared observability + sample prompts.
- Ask from you: estimated token volumes (avg & peak), target unit economics ($ per 1M tokens), and any procurement timeline constraints.
- We recommended: start with an initial credit pool so you can validate latency and reranking at scale.

Attached: pilot-quote.pdf (high-level credit options) and a small sample usage CSV I exported from the demo (pilot-usage.csv).

To help us size this correctly, could you confirm:
1) Expected average tokens/day during the pilot (rough ballpark ok).
2) Peak tokens/day we should plan capacity for.
3) Target $/1M tokens or monthly budget range you'd want to hit (helps us choose committed vs on-demand pricing).

If you want, we can also extend the pilot credits mid-test if burn is higher than expected — I'll need rough numbers to make the ask to finance.

Next steps: if you confirm the numbers today, I can propose an extension/credits approval and a one-page mutual action plan (MaP) to keep things moving.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182

Attachment: pilot-quote.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
Attachment: pilot-usage.csv (CSV, 14KB)

From: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits & pricing follow-up

Thanks Marissa — good meeting on our side as well. Answers below (rough estimates):

1) Average tokens/day during pilot: ~3,000,000 tokens/day (this is user-facing inference from chat + some batch reranking), so ~90M tokens/month.
2) Peak tokens/day: up to ~6,000,000 tokens/day during peak campaigns (we expect spikes when we ramp).
3) Target unit economics: our finance/ops team is looking for ~$150-$200 per 1M tokens to make the long-term unit economics work given our margin targets. For the pilot, our internal budget is ~$15k but we can stretch if we see strong performance.

Would you be able to provision an initial credit pool of $15k and a rapid top-up/extension option if we hit high burn? If you can map the $/1M numbers to what Redwood would propose (committed vs on-demand) that will help our procurement review.

Also cc'ing Samantha (ops) who will own usage monitoring during the pilot.

—John
John Doe
Head of Product Ops | Acme Corp
john.doe@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits & pricing follow-up

Thanks John — super helpful. Summary of what I hear and a proposed credit/pricing plan: 

Summary of your estimates (confirmed):
- ~3M tokens/day average (~90M/month)
- Peaks to ~6M/day
- Target $/1M tokens: $150-$200
- Internal pilot budget: ~$15k (may be extended if we see strong signals)

Redwood proposal (options):
1) On-demand pilot (no commit): $220 per 1M tokens (standard on-demand). For your expected 90M tokens/month that would be ~$19,800/month.
2) Pilot commitment (30-day committed tier for evaluation pricing): $180 per 1M tokens with a short term (30-day) commitment — for 90M/month that equates to ~$16,200. This gets you a predictable unit price and lower cost than on-demand.

Credit proposal: we can approve an initial $30,000 pilot credit (approval in place pending signature of the one-page MaP) to cover your burn and give room for peak days. Rough math: at $180/1M tokens, $30k covers ~166.6M tokens (~1.85x your expected monthly consumption). At $220/1M tokens, $30k covers ~136.4M tokens.

If Acme signs the MaP, we can provision credits within 24 hours and set up a burn-rate monitor (cc'ing Rishi who will enable alerts). We can also auto-extend credits after a quick review if you hit >80% of the pool before day 14.

Next steps: 
- Please confirm which pricing option you prefer (on-demand vs 30-day committed).
- If you accept the $30k credit proposal, confirm the signatory and I'll route the MaP + DocuSign link.

I'll also attach a short breakdown in the MaP so procurement can see unit economics by price tier.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182

Attachment: pilot-quote.pdf (revised)

From: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits & pricing follow-up

Works for us — we prefer the 30-day committed pilot at $180/1M tokens and accept the $30k credit pool. Signatory will be our procurement lead (Samantha Lee) — she is cc'd.

Please send the MaP + DocuSign and we will aim to countersign within 48 hours. Also please enable the burn-rate alerts you mentioned (email/SMS to our ops leads).

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—John
